findings.root_cause: fetch_and_analyze Step 1 (4-source fan-out) + Step 4 (ragIndex fan-out) can together reach 55-65 s wall clock, exceeding the ~60 s MCP tool response budget.
findings.primary_offender: reuters slot: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000) was correct for the old direct external RSS call but is now a local Docker HTTP call to news-fetch:5008 — 30 s budget is 2x too large for an in-network call. Any concurrent load on news-fetch causes the slot to hold at 25-30 s.
findings.secondary_offender: vneconomy fetcher runs 2 feeds serially inside one Promise (2x 15 s axios = up to 30 s per slot). No outer per-source timeout guard.
findings.tertiary_offender: ragHttpClient ragIndex() and ragSearch() have NO AbortSignal. Under post-OOM rag-service restart, each call can hang 30-60 s. Promise.all waits for the slowest individual ragIndex call.
findings.promise_all_vs_allSettled: Step 1 uses Promise.all — a hung reuters slot holds all results until timeout, preventing partial delivery from cafef/vnexpress/vneconomy.
findings.ingestion_redundancy: VPS push pipeline already ingests all 4 sources every 15 min into rag_analyses (normalised + indexed). Off-hours news-scout re-fetches live from the same sources, duplicating network work unnecessarily.
findings.false_positive_cleared: ingestion pipeline (VPS -> push-news -> pollNews -> rag_analyses) is FULLY GREEN — confirmed by cowork probe at 04:10Z. The timeout is isolated to the on-demand fetch_and_analyze MCP tool path only.

recommendations.title: Per-source timeout budget
recommendations.shape: Wrap each fetchPromises.push(...) call in Promise.race([sourceFn(), timeoutToEmpty(budgetMs)]). Proposed budgets: cafef=10s, vnexpress=10s, vneconomy=12s, reuters=15s (from 30s). On timeout resolve to [] (match existing .catch()=>[] pattern). Total Step 1 ceiling drops from 30s to 15s.
recommendations.risk: low — timeout-to-empty is already the reuters error path. No new failure modes.

recommendations.title: Promise.allSettled fan-out for Step 1
recommendations.shape: Replace Promise.all(fetchPromises) with Promise.allSettled(fetchPromises) and flatMap fulfilled results. Mechanics: settled.flatMap(r => r.status==='fulfilled' ? r.value : []).slice(0, limit). One hung slot can no longer stall the entire batch.
recommendations.risk: zero — already handle partial arrays throughout Steps 2-5.

recommendations.title: AbortSignal guard on ragIndex and ragSearch
recommendations.shape: Add signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000) to both ragIndex() and ragSearch() fetch() calls in ragHttpClient.ts. 8 s is generous for a local Docker call and eliminates the infinite-hang path under rag-service restart. Also add signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000) to the outer Promise.all in Step 4 (belt+suspenders).
recommendations.risk: low — ragIndex errors are already caught and logged in the per-entry try/catch; missing an index entry on timeout is non-fatal.

recommendations.title: Lighter already-ingested DB read path
recommendations.shape: Add optional use_ingested: boolean + since_minutes: number (default 120) params to fetch_and_analyze. When use_ingested=true skip Steps 1+4 entirely; read rag_analyses WHERE created_at >= datetime('now', '-N minutes') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?. Wall clock drops from 30s to <5ms. Off-hours news-scout should use this path.
recommendations.qa_gate: Unit test: ragIndex NOT called when use_ingested=true. Integration test: since_minutes filter returns only rows within window. Non-regression: existing call with use_ingested=false (default) unchanged.

rationale_for_no_ship: REC-1 and REC-2 together require editing analysis.ts (interface layer) — simple mechanical changes but they modify the live tool handler. Per spike constraint, no production fix without a QA gate. REC-3 touches ragHttpClient.ts (infrastructure layer). None qualifies as a 'one-line obviously safe bound' because all three touch the live call path of a tool that is currently deployed and in use by the scheduler (intelligenceCycleJob pollNews is stubbed to [] but fetch_and_analyze is called by the cowork agents directly). The combined REC-1+2+3 fix is a single small PR but requires a real QA scenario (inject a slow mock source, verify timeout fires, verify partial results returned).
qa_required_for_fix: Inject a mock source that sleeps 20s — verify fetch_and_analyze returns within 20s with partial results from other sources (REC-1+2).
Inject a slow ragIndex mock that sleeps 15s — verify Step 4 completes within 10s (REC-3).
Call fetch_and_analyze(use_ingested=true) — verify ragIndex NOT called, SQLite read path used, result contains rows from last 2h.
Non-regression: existing fetch_and_analyze(use_ingested=false default) call path unchanged.
